answer.term: A minimum of five years from installation, expected on 2 March 2026.
answer.renewal: Continues from year to year after the minimum period.
answer.notice: At least six months' written notice, ending at the end of the minimum period or of a later year.
answer.fees: €9,600 per quarter in advance for rental and maintenance; out-of-hours call-outs €180 each. Payable within 45 days.
